sql: SELECT 'conv' AS k, json_build_object('id', c.id, 'created', c.created_at, 'step', c.bot_step, 'enabled', c.bot_enabled, 'bd', c.bot_data, 'lead', c.lead_id, 'last', c.last_message_at)::text AS v FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.instance_id = '75feab3b-eb12-44f0-8ada-463e5540c869' AND c.remote_jid LIKE '%81121710%' UNION ALL SELECT 'msg', json_build_object('t', m.timestamp, 'me', m.from_me, 'type', m.message_type, 'meta', m.metadata, 'c', left(m.content, 50))::text FROM (SELECT m.* FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.instance_id = '75feab3b-eb12-44f0-8ada-463e5540c869' AND c.remote_jid LIKE '%81121710%' ORDER BY m.timestamp DESC LIMIT 5) m
